previews_hostname_check.name: previews_hostname_check
previews_hostname_check.value:
length("previews"."hostname") between 1 and 253
    and "previews"."hostname" not glob '*[^a-z0-9.-]*'
    and "previews"."hostname" not like '.%'
    and "previews"."hostname" not like '%.'
    and "previews"."hostname" not like '%..%'

  )
